name: Slack green deploys
ownerWords: look, YOUR JOB IS TO MAKE SURE THE SOFTWARE IS DURABLE. 자체적으로 고쳐질 수 있게 설계를 바꾸는게 니 역할이야
goal: Every push to slack-green main reaches the Railway worker (when it touches packages/backend) and Vercel production within 20 minutes. A deploy that Railway skips because a CI check failed is redeployed once by the precheck itself, and any other skip, failure or stuck deploy is reported to the chat.

metrics.label: Railway worker skipped, failed, stuck or missing a main commit
Vercel production failed, stuck or missing the main head
Data sources that failed in this check

onMiss: source_errors: fix the precheck or its login first. A Railway skip the precheck already redeployed (flag redeploy) needs no hand fix: tell the chat which commit was skipped and why, and check on the next run that the worker went live. A redeploy_error, a failed or stuck worker deploy, or a second skip of the same commit: read `railway deployment list --json` and the build logs, tell the chat in one line with the commit and the status, and start one fix job for the cause (for a CI skip, the failing check suite on that commit). Vercel failed or stuck: read the deployment's build log and tell the chat; a missing deployment means GitHub sent no push event, fixed by an empty commit through a PR, never `vercel redeploy`. Never merge, and never deploy anything but main's head.
